app.title: Genesy Till
app.tagline: Point of sale and cash payouts.

setup.title: Pair this till
setup.hint: In Office, open Till › Registers and press “Pair a till”. Type the code shown there.
setup.wrong: The shop name and code don't match. Check both and try again.
setup.used: This code has expired or was already used. Ask the office for a new one.
setup.locked: Too many tries. Wait 15 minutes, then try again.
setup.failed: Couldn't reach the server. Check the connection and try again.

login.title: Who’s at the till?
login.locked: Too many wrong PINs. Try again later.
login.keyRefused: This till was disconnected or paired elsewhere. Pair it again with a new code from the office.
login.expired: Your session ended. Log in again to continue.
login.usersFailed: Couldn't load the till users. Check the connection and reload.
login.noUsers: No till users yet. Ask the office to add one.
login.missing: Missing? Ask the office to add you under Till › Users.

sale.title: Sale
sale.scan: Scan a barcode or type a name
sale.estimateHint: Offline: catalog prices incl. VAT. The server's total, rounding and change come with the sale when it syncs.
sale.savedHint: The till is offline. This sale is kept on this device and sent once the connection is back.
sale.noShift: No shift is open on this register. Cash sales need an open shift.
sale.catalogEmpty: This register has no products to sell yet. Ask the office.
sale.catalogFailed: Couldn't load the product list. Check the connection.
sale.catalogStale: Couldn't refresh the product list. Showing the copy on this device.
sale.mismatch: Some prices differ from the current catalog. The office will see this.
sale.basketCount: Basket · {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}
sale.referenceHint: Run the card on the terminal first, then type its slip number.
sale.quoteRefused: The basket could not be priced.

drawer.none: No shift is open on this register.
drawer.queued: {count, plural, one {# offline sale} other {# offline sales}} still to sync. Sync before closing the shift.
drawer.loadFailed: Couldn't load the drawer. Check the connection.
drawer.opened: Shift opened. You can start selling.
drawer.floatHint: Count what goes in the drawer to start the shift.
drawer.closedBody: The office sees this on the shift report. Nothing else to do here.
drawer.refused: The drawer could not be changed.

count.invalid: Each row needs a value (e.g. 5.00) and a whole number of pieces.
count.padHint: The pad types into the selected row ({row}).

receipt.mismatch: This sale was charged at prices that differ from the current catalog. The office will see it.

queue.title: Offline sales
queue.badge: {count, plural, =0 {Offline sales synced} one {# sale to sync} other {# sales to sync}}
queue.emptyHint: Sales rung up without a connection wait here until they are sent.
queue.showOffice: This sale was not booked. Show it to the office before dismissing it.
queue.mismatch: Charged at prices that differ from the current catalog. The office will see it.
queue.unsellable: A product in this sale is no longer for sale. The office will see it.
queue.needsOffice: {count, plural, one {# needs the office} other {# need the office}}
queue.otherUser: Rung up by {name}. Sent once {name} logs in on this till.
queue.otherRegister: Rung up on register {register}. It is only sent from that register.
queue.unknownOrigin: It is not known which register rang up this sale, so it is not sent.

errors.crashBody: Sales waiting to sync are still kept on this device. Try again, or go back to the sale screen.

offline.title: Offline — sales are kept on this device
offline.body: They are sent as soon as the connection is back. Totals are estimates until then.

refusals.refReused: This sale's number was already used for another sale. Show it to the office.
refusals.noShift: No shift is open on this register. Open the drawer first.
refusals.alreadyOpen: A shift is already open on this register.
refusals.insufficientStock: Not enough stock for a product in this sale. Ask the office to correct the stock, then try again.
refusals.notStep: Cash refunds go in whole cash steps. Pay the rest by card.
refusals.needsConfirmed: Record a card refund only after the terminal confirmed it.
refusals.beforeBook: This sale is older than the books. Return it from the office.
refusals.stale: Something changed since the check. Check again.
refusals.notActive: The books of this account aren't live yet. Ask the office.

approval.title: Manager approval
approval.hint: A manager signs in with their own email and password. A till PIN doesn't count.
approval.offlineBody: Refunds, returns and drawer adjustments need a manager's live approval. They are never saved for later. Try again when the till is back online.
approval.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
approval.noAccount: This login has no account to approve in.
approval.missingRight: This person may not approve this. Ask a manager who may.
approval.otherAccount: This person isn't part of this till's account.
approval.tillEnded: The till session ended. Lock and log in again.

returns.lookupFailed: The sale couldn't be looked up. Try again.
returns.restock: Put the goods back on the shelf
returns.returned: Return booked. Refund the credit below.
returns.cashElsewhere: Cash goes back only from the drawer of {register}. Here you can record a card refund.
returns.stepHint: Cash goes in steps of {step}. Pay any rest by card.

adjust.title: Adjust drawer cash
adjust.hint: Count the drawer. The difference with what it should hold is booked with the manager's approval.
